<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/dex/orders/{boxId}/cancel"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Return an outstanding order's ERG and tokens to this wallet. Accepted while the order is `PENDING` or `OPEN`. A fill sent before the cancel can still confirm first, and the cancel is then dropped. No body.
